# deps: tools: add ref for git-vertag

Annotate the `git-vertag` pin in [toolset/go.mod](../../toolset/go.mod) (line 15 at the time) with a link to [kyoh86/git-vertag#14](https://github.com/kyoh86/git-vertag/issues/14) — the upstream issue asking for a Go-module-compatible `v2` path, the reason the tool could not be pinned to its v2.0.4 release ([#380](DOT-379.md)).
